leads.title: Agência Diadorim research
leads.documents: Documents 16 anti-LGBTQ bills introduced in the Legislative Assembly of Paraná
leads.detail: Cited in lead paragraph; no URL visible in provided text

leads.title: General Inspector of Justice of Paraná - Ruling of 26 March 2013
leads.documents: Rules same-sex marriage and conversion of stable unions to marriage should be possible using normal marriage procedures in Paraná
leads.detail: Date: 26 March 2013; issuer: General Inspector of Justice of Paraná; no URL visible

leads.title: Court of Justice of the State of Paraná (TJPR) - 2023 provision on non-binary marker
leads.documents: Published provision guaranteeing inclusion of term 'non-binary' in gender marker of Civil Registry, then revoked in November 2023 limiting administrative replacement to 'male' and 'female'
leads.detail: Year: 2023, revocation: November 2023; no URL visible

leads.title: Court of Justice of the State of Paraná (TJPR) - 2025 third gender authorization
leads.documents: Authorizes a third gender option on documents in Paraná

leads.title: City of Londrina Law of 26 April 2024 - trans sports ban
leads.documents: Bans transgender people from competing in sports according to gender identity, establishes R$ 10,000.00 fine for non-compliance
leads.detail: Enacted: 26 April 2024, Londrina; fine R$10,000.00; no URL visible

leads.title: Supreme Federal Court (STF) challenges to Londrina law - Cármen Lúcia injunction and Cristiano Zanin vote
leads.documents: Documents enforcement/rights machinery: March 2026 lawsuit by LGBTQ rights organizations, 26 Feb 2026 motion to bar athlete Tiffanny Abreu from Brazilian Women's Volleyball Cup, Brazilian Volleyball Confederation lawsuit, preliminary injunction by Justice Cármen Lúcia allowing competition, 7 Aug 2026 vote by rapporteur Justice Cristiano Zanin to strike down law
leads.detail: Dates: 26 Feb 2026, March 2026, 7 Aug 2026; Justices Cármen Lúcia, Cristiano Zanin; no URL visible

leads.title: Ministry of Human Rights and Citizenship resolution on school restrooms + Curitiba City Council protest motion of 4 Oct 2023
leads.documents: Federal recommendation that students use public restrooms in schools in accordance with gender identity, and local protest motion against it in Curitiba
leads.detail: Motion date: 4 October 2023, Curitiba City Council; no URL visible

leads.title: Curitiba unisex bathroom bans - Mara Lima (PSC) state bill 2021 and Ezequias Barros (PMB) municipal bill approved 16 Nov 2021
leads.documents: Documents proposed/enacted restrictions on bathroom access by gender identity in Paraná and Curitiba
leads.detail: State rep Mara Lima 2021 proposal; councilman Ezequias Barros bill approved 16 November 2021 in Curitiba; no URL visible

leads.title: Brazilian Supreme Court ruling of 13 June 2019 on discrimination
leads.documents: Rules discrimination on basis of sexual orientation and gender identity is a crime akin to racism - national anti-discrimination protection applicable in Paraná

leads.title: Paraná State Law on gender-neutral language - approved 13 Dec 2022, signed 18 Jan 2023, challenged 15 Dec
leads.documents: Prohibits gender-neutral language in schools, signed by Governor Ratinho Júnior; lawsuit by National LGBTI Alliance and Brazilian Association of Homotransaffective Families in STF
leads.detail: Approved: 13 Dec 2022 Legislative Assembly of Paraná; signed: 18 Jan 2023; challenge: 15 Dec by National LGBTI Alliance; no URL visible
